matched_note.title: UPSC Daily Current Affairs & Editorial Analysis Strategy: The Hindu & Indian Express in 30 Minutes

drafted_comment:
The real issue with monthly current affairs is getting overwhelmed by the sheer volume of news. Instead of just reading everything, you need to filter it.

1. Map every news item to a GS syllabus keyword (Society, Governance, Economy, etc.).
2. Only note down facts that have 3 pillars: a Constitutional article, a hard statistic, and a specific committee report.
3. Stop spending hours on manual note-making; use syllabus-mapped summaries to stay ahead.

(For free, syllabus-mapped daily notes and MCQs, check on satyadheesh portal)
